use: Research evidence only. Not a trading signal, not advice, and not used by the live signal path.
title: Strategy experiments: registered variants, hold caps, risk bases and the paper tracker
headline: 74,032 breakout signals x 5 registered variants x 3 hold caps. Test-period net expectancy at the registered 60-bar cap runs from -0.049 R (a_atr_stop_fixed_3r) to -0.024 R (b_donchian_trail_10). Paper tracker replay: 12,157 positions, 0 mismatches. Hindsight label: 22% of signals later reached a favourable excursion of at least 5R within 120 bars (a peak, not a P&L); the best registered variant's test-period net expectancy is -0.024 R (not positive).
caveats: Historical, point-in-time research on the parent strategy's breakout signals; not signals, not advice, not a live rule. No variant, job or paper trade is active in production.
Each registered variant is accounted on its own: one open position per symbol, direction and hold cap (the live ledger's rule); entry is the next bar's open; costs are round-trip bps charged in R.

The registered definition has a 60-bar cap. 120 and 250 bars are research conditions, not registered identities. Positions whose history ends before their cap are excluded, so every cap is compared on the same signals.

Standardised R uses 1R = 2 x ATR14 for every variant. The variant's ACTUAL initial risk differs (B starts at the 10-bar channel low, C at 3 x ATR); both bases are shown, and actual-risk multiples blow up when that risk is tiny.

The one-open-position rule skips most signals (breakouts cluster on consecutive days), so each variant's accounted positions are a minority of the signals; 'max drawdown (cum R)' is the drawdown of the running SUM of R over all of a variant's positions in exit order, with every position counted at 1R: it is not a sized portfolio.
Train/test is chronological by signal date with an embargo and a purge. The selection rules are simple baselines fitted on train only; the per-signal oracle is an unattainable upper bound.
Universe: 74,032 signals of the SEC study's liquid symbols; catalysts use only events whose reaction session completed before the signal session.

'Big winner' is a HINDSIGHT label: the maximum favourable excursion within 120 bars of the entry, a peak nobody can sell at. It is never a feature or a rule; decision-time (pit_) conditions and hindsight (hs_) measurements are separate columns.

Capture ratio, premature exit and missed continuation are measured after the fact. A model that ranks signals by decision-time features is judged chronologically, against single-feature baselines, with a purge of train labels that overlap the test period.
The forward paper tracker has been dry-run and shadow-tested on a scratch restore only. It has not been activated in production; no forward paper observation exists there.

provenance.source: ml_breakout_dataset_v2 signals, stock_prices and the committed SEC event table on an isolated copy of the production backup; identities checked against the production registry rows

split.purge: a train signal whose position is still open at test_start is dropped from train

execution.entry: open of the bar after the signal
execution.one_open_position_per: variant, hold cap, symbol, direction (the live ledger's rule); a signal on or before the previous exit bar is skipped
risk_bases: actual: distance from entry to the variant's own initial stop
execution.censoring: a trade whose price history ends before its hold cap is excluded and counted

universe.definition: symbols of the SEC earnings study (391 liquid names)

signal_source.analysis_set: full longest-cap window, finite bars, no price discontinuity in [i-5, i+251]

strategy_selection_baselines_cap60_std_n.note: rules are fitted on TRAIN rows only; the per-signal oracle is an unattainable upper bound; signals on their own (counterfactual), not position-accounted

definition.big_winner: favourable excursion >= 5R (R = 2 x ATR) within 120 bars of the entry: a HINDSIGHT label, never a feature or a rule
definition.premature_exit: price continues >= 2R beyond the exit within 60 bars (hindsight)
definition.capture_ratio: realised return / favourable excursion over the shortest horizon covering the hold
definition.label_purge: train signals within 180 days of the test start are purged (their label window overlaps the test period)
definition.decision_time_vs_hindsight: pit_* columns/features are known at the signal close; hs_* columns need later bars

ml_ready_table.point_in_time: features use bars <= the signal bar; the catalyst is the latest earnings event whose reaction session completed BEFORE the signal session, with its SEC acceptance timestamp
ml_ready_table.purge_note: split_cap60 = 'purged' for a train-period signal whose position under ANY variant (cap 60) is still open at the test start
